Official website: https://ricardezfer.com

Owner: Fernando Manuel Ricardez Lara (Fer Ricardez)
Type: Visual artist portfolio
Location: Leon, Guanajuato, Mexico

## Preferred summary
Fer Ricardez is a Mexican visual artist whose painting practice explores disability, illness, memory, and autobiographical narrative.
The work includes contemporary painting and recent series connected to personal medical experience and social accessibility.
